question: The Pulitzer Awards are administered by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Columbia University, New York**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pulitzer Awards are administered by **The Columbia University, New York**.
 
• The awards were established by provisions in the will of Joseph Pulitzer, a renowned newspaper publisher, who left money to Columbia University upon his death in 1911.
 
• The first Pulitzer Prizes were awarded on June 4, 1917, and they have been awarded annually ever since.
 
• The awards cover multiple categories, including journalism, literature, and musical composition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joseph Pulitzer** was a Hungarian-American newspaper publisher who is best known for establishing the Pulitzer Prizes.
 
• The Pulitzer Prizes are considered to be the most prestigious awards in the fields they cover, particularly in journalism.
 
• Each year, the awards are announced in April, and the winners receive a certificate and a cash award.
 
• The Columbia University Graduate School of Journalism administers the awards and oversees the judging process.
